note: What each installed tt-model container package does with MODEL_WEIGHTS_DIR (issue 73). A weights-only bring-up swaps the new weights into a model directory and serves the package against it. A package whose generator downloads a constant repository ignores that directory and serves the base model, so its test measures the wrong model. Status hard-coded blocks the base check. Status honours and status unprobed pass. To probe a package, follow docs/weights-source.md and change its row with the evidence.

raahemnabeel/qwen3-coder-30b-a3b.evidence: Stage 2 of a weights-only bring-up of a Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B fine-tune (the validation run of issue 60): the container's server log shows 'Fetching 28 files' from the Hub while the swap check reported 32 of 32 tokens matching, so the test measured the base model. The package's generator calls snapshot_download with a constant repository and revision.

raahemnabeel/qwen3-coder-next.evidence: Probe on 2026-11-03 (image tt-model/qwen3-coder-next:0c170421ca1b, profile p300, 2 chips): the container started with the Hub off, an empty /hf and MODEL_WEIGHTS_DIR set to a stub directory that held the base model's config, tokenizer files and shard index but no shard. Not shown: what it does when a tokenizer or config file is missing from the directory, and the packages with other images (-blackhole, -blackhole-fast) are separate rows.
